title: Pick and pack an order
summary: Take a box, pick the items on the order, check them, pack and seal.

steps.title: Take a medium box
steps.instruction: Take a medium box (M) and put the order sheet on top of it.
steps.say: Take a medium box and put the order sheet on top.

criteria: An open cardboard box is on the table

source.quote: Medium box for up to five items, the big ones only for bulky stuff.

steps.title: Pick the items
steps.instruction: Pick every item on the order from the shelf into the box.
steps.say: Pick the three items on the order into the box.

criteria: Every order line is in the box

source.quote: Always check the litre size, the 0.5 l and 1 l cartons look the same.

steps.title: Check the order
steps.instruction: Hold the open box in view. Owl checks the items against the order.
steps.say: Hold the open box in front of you. I'll check it.

criteria: Every order line is in the box

source.quote: Check every order against the order sheet before you pack it.

steps.title: Pack heavy items first
steps.instruction: Heavy items at the bottom, light on top. Fill gaps with paper.
steps.say: Heavy items at the bottom, light ones on top. Fill the gaps with paper.

criteria: Cartons lie at the bottom of the box

source.quote: Pack heavy items at the bottom and fill empty space with paper so nothing moves.

steps.title: Seal and label
steps.instruction: Tape the box shut and put the shipping label on top.
steps.say: Tape the box shut and put the label on top. Then pinch Done.

criteria: The shipping label is on the top side

source.quote: The label always goes on the top side, never over the tape.
